title: Maria's finger bones tested in Sri Lanka come back male and female

tellings.quote: Number three, UFO researcher Steve Mera told me that two different finger bones of one of the M types, Maria, were genetically tested in Sri Lanka.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, discusses strange three-fingered bodies said to come from Peru, one of which is known as Maria. He says a UFO researcher named Steve Mera told him that two different finger bones from Maria were genetically tested in Sri Lanka in the 2020s. According to Mera, one came back male and the other female, which would be hard to explain for a single body.
